transcriber_notes: 705x911 JPEG screenshot of a SnowPro-style Windows form (French labels), no app branding -> source_format 'other'. Printed date 12/02/2013 (D/M/Y, matches file name). Height axis 2.70 px/cm (gridlines every 10 cm; 200 cm at y=299, 0 at y=839). Boundaries from the thick blue bar lines: 152.4/138.1/131.3/114.3/104.3/73.1/34.3 -> 152/138/131/114/104/73/34; the HW column (water equivalent) = thickness x density for every legible row (e.g. 39 cm x 390 = 152, 34 cm x 380 = 129), confirming them. Hardness axis (bars grow leftward from the right edge x=327) is geometric: F/4F/1F/P/K at 13/27/54/108/216 px; bar widths 13 (F), 54 (1F), 108 (P) and 148 px (between P and K, nearer P -> P+, matching the R-column '+' symbol). R column symbols (none/X/double slash/double slash +) track hardness and were not transcribed separately. Temperature axis: -20..0 C labels on gridlines 27 px apart (13.5 px/C), 0 C at x=300 (4F gridline); hollow circle markers read to +-0.1 C; no marker at 30 cm or at the surface; the line continues dashed from 140 cm to the top of the axis at 0 C (air temp blank, not recorded). Header total 'Eau 500' vs sum of legible HW (397) implies the hidden 104-73 cm row, but its density is not shown and is left null. theta (moisture) column blank for all layers.
